title: Centre in the Square

services.name: Season Tickets
services.desc: Direct from New York! Enjoy the best of Broadway at Centre In The Square with Season Tickets. One Season Ticket package includes the same seat for all four Broadway performances, and saves you almost 25% compared to buying each show separately. Please note: Prices shown below are for the full 4-show Broadway Season Ticket package, not for one individual show. Your package includes one ticket to each of the four Broadway shows in the same seat. As an added bonus, Broadway in Kitchener passholders get to purchase tickets for The Book of Mormon before the general public. Centre In The Square is operated by a not-for-profit registered charity. services.desc: Give your child a summer they’ll remember forever - filled with creativity, confidence, and the thrill of performing on the biggest stage in the region. Our Performing Arts Summer Camps are led by professional artists, designed for every age and experience level, and culminate in live performances on the Centre In The Square Main Stage.Perfect for returning campers and brand-new performers alike. This program is an ideal entryway for establishing skills in the performing arts. Campers bring a favourite storybook to life through movement games, dancing, singing, crafts, and imaginative play.
